context: User requests a brand-new original sketch about a fictional transport 'on time' redefinition policy, exercising the core generation workflow end to end.

checklist.name: correct_two_hander_structure
checklist.description: Exactly two alternating speaking roles (interviewer and a generic spokesperson), no stage direction or physical comedy.

checklist.name: literal_confident_answers
checklist.description: The spokesperson answers with literal, confident logic rather than nervousness or emotional defensiveness.

checklist.name: incremental_escalation
checklist.description: The exchange escalates one logical step at a time rather than front-loading the most absurd consequence.

checklist.name: flat_deadpan_maintained
checklist.description: Neither character shows outrage, sarcasm-with-a-wink, or explicit moralizing at any point.

checklist.name: unresolved_understated_close
checklist.description: The sketch ends on a flat, understated line and the absurd policy is not resolved, apologized for, or reversed.
